hints.title: Tier Alternation Obstacle
hints.text: Standard level-by-level processing traverses all tiers from left to right. How can alternating the order of collection per tier produce the required zigzag sequence without altering the child visitation order?

hints.title: Directional Buffer Invariant
hints.text: Process each tier using standard FIFO ordering, but reverse the tier's collected values or alternate insertion directions on odd levels.

hints.title: Flagged Level Traversal Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a queue with the root if non-null. Track an alternating direction flag. For each level, record queue size, pop all nodes, append their values to a level list, and push children. Reverse the level list if the flag indicates right-to-left, append to result, and flip the flag.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree (0 <= N <= 2000)
W: maximum width of tree (up to N/2)
complexity.notes: Breadth-first traversal visiting each node once and reversing level slices in linear aggregate time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing with depth recursion requires sorting or re-indexing nodes post-traversal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Queue memory matches the maximum tree level width.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using queue level size snapshot and reversing only the extracted level array.
